hint.en: Fires when the assistant's spoken reply has been rendered to an audio file, with a link a speaker can play, and for the app's own feedback sounds (an error, a missing API key, the greeting after pairing). Only fires when the device's "Reply audio" setting is set to send the reply to a Flow — use it to play the assistant's own voice on a Sonos or any other speaker that can play a URL. A reply link is only valid for a couple of minutes, so play it right away rather than storing it.
